text: I discovered an account with XXXX XXXX that I never opened. I received a card in the mail for a credit card I did not apply for. When I called they confirmed an account was opened in XX/XX/XXXX using my information. I have never authorized this and I am a victim of identity theft. This is now showing on my credit report and I need it removed immediately.
note: HIGH expected -- unauthorized account / identity theft (clear regulated harm)

text: I have disputed this same incorrect balance THREE times. The account shows a past due amount of $XXXX that I already paid in full in XX/XX/XXXX. I sent proof of payment. They keep verifying it as accurate without investigating. This error is hurting my credit score and I have been denied a loan because of it.
note: HIGH expected -- credit-report error persists after dispute (FCRA)

text: I am very unhappy with this bank. I went to my local branch and it closed at XXXX even though the website said it was open later. The teller was rude and I waited almost 30 minutes. I have been a customer for years and this is not the service I expect. I am thinking about switching banks.
note: LOW expected -- service dissatisfaction, no alleged violation

text: I sent a wire transfer of $XXXX to someone I met online who said they would help me invest. Now I cannot reach them and the money is gone. I asked my bank to reverse it but they said they cannot. I think the bank should have warned me this was a scam. Someone needs to give me my money back.
note: AMBIGUOUS -- authorized-push-payment scam; bank liability unclear, regulatory flag expected

text: Something is going on with my accounts and I cannot get a straight answer. Money came out that I do not think I authorized, and there is also a charge from XX/XX/XXXX that I do not recognize. When I checked, there was an account or service listed that I do not remember opening. I have called XXXX several times and each person tells me something different and sends me to another department. Honestly I am not sure if this is a problem with my card, my checking account, or something on my credit report. I just need someone to figure out what actually happened and make it stop.
note: AMBIGUOUS -- genuinely unclear product (card vs deposit vs credit report) and unclear if fraud or error; should yield LOW confidence and trip the human-hold gate
